description: This file defines the Publisher class responsible for managing Confluence page publishing, including diffing, creating, updating, and recursive page handling within a Confluence space.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: Handles publishing and diffing of pages to Confluence, including recursive creation and updates, space configuration, and diff visualization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Publisher with configuration, API client, output interface, and width.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a run action with a title, width, and closure.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Recursively compares local and remote page structures, outputting differences.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Main method to publish a page tree, handling existing pages, diffs, creation, and updates.

methods.name: rootNotFound
methods.description: Handles error when root page is not found and suggests configuration.

methods.name: configureSpace
methods.description: Configures the Confluence space based on a page's space key.

methods.name: getRootPage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the root page for the given page tree.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page under a parent ID.

methods.name: createPlaceholderPage
methods.description: Creates a placeholder page when no content is available.

methods.name: recursiveWithCallback
methods.description: Recursively processes page entries with a callback function.

methods.name: createRecursive
methods.description: Recursively creates pages and placeholders based on page entries.

methods.name: updateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively updates pages based on differences.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates a page if content has changed, and uploads attachments.
